INIT Init
NEXT Next
VIEW vars

CONSTRAINT SCDraw_Login_Budget

wrapper.name: SCDraw_Login
wrapper.text:
---- MODULE SCDraw_Login ----
EXTENDS Login
LOCAL INSTANCE Naturals
SCDraw_Login_TLC == INSTANCE TLC
SCDraw_Login_Budget == SCDraw_Login_TLC!TLCGet("distinct") <= 500
SCDraw_Login_Broken == (IF NeverLocked THEN {} ELSE {"NeverLocked"})
SCDraw_Login_Mark == IF SCDraw_Login_Broken = {} THEN TRUE ELSE SCDraw_Login_TLC!PrintT(<<"00000000000000000000000000000000", <<screen, tries>>, SCDraw_Login_Broken>>)
====
